claims.text: Overall Green Forest fire in France from 22 Jul 2026 00:00 UTC to 23 Jul 2026 00:00 UTC. Forest fire can have a low humanitarian impact based on the burned area and the affected population and their vulnerability. About 6,769 hectares burned and roughly 2,984 people in the affected area.

GDACS event report (eventid 1029628, episode 8): forest fire in France covering a 22-25 July 2026 window, citing about 25,692 hectares burned and roughly 9,447 people in the fire-affected area, assessed as low humanitarian impact based on burned area and affected population.

description: A fast-moving wildfire broke out in the Gironde department of southwestern France on 22 July 2026 and spread rapidly toward Bordeaux amid extreme heat and strong winds, prompting evacuation orders for suburbs on the city's western edge, including areas near its airport. GDACS's event report puts the burned area at about 25,700 hectares as of 25 July 2026, with roughly 9,447 people in the fire-affected area, and the fire remained active with continuing thermal-anomaly detections through today. Widely reported figures — evacuations variously put at around 110,000 to 141,000 people, French military mobilisation ordered by President Macron, and activation of the EU Civil Protection Mechanism — have not yet been confirmed by an allowlisted authoritative source.

impact.summary: GDACS's event report (eventid 1029628, episode 8) assessed a Green alert for low humanitarian impact for a forest fire in France covering 22-25 July 2026, citing about 25,692 hectares burned and roughly 9,447 people in the fire-affected area, with the most recent thermal-anomaly detection on 25 July 2026 — up sharply from 6,769 hectares/2,984 people affected when the event was first opened on 22-23 July. No allowlisted authoritative source has yet published a confirmed death toll or evacuation count for this fire; widely reported figures of 110,000-141,000 people evacuated, French military mobilisation, and EU Civil Protection Mechanism activation come from non-allowlisted media and have not been independently confirmed here.

location.region: Gironde department (near Bordeaux and the Landes border)
